title: Hexecution: Fun with Turn-based Hex Tile Strategy Roguelite, play for free on itch.io
author: thetinytrex
selftext:
Working on a hex-based strategy roguelite where tiles are your cards and form of navigation and skills. Different classes play differently with the tiles. Your goal is to eliminate the target by dawn. It's a simple idea but I found it very flexible and fun to expand on. New classes, new regions, new tiles. the core system makes for a lot of fun ways to play. I have 3 classes up on [itch.io](http://itch.io) and was considering on releasing it to the play store. I have more classes built like a teleport class and a poisoner and working on more regions. It already works well on my phone and I found it fun to play on-the-go. I just made this since it felt like a cool concept and I always want to do something with hex tiles. 

Play in your browser (should work on mobile) for free on itch.io: [https://servbotz.itch.io/hexecution](https://servbotz.itch.io/hexecution)

Interested to know your feedback if you do play it. 

Built entirely with Godot + Opus 5.5.
